description.value: The Alix Goolden Performance Hall is the principal concert venue of the Victoria Conservatory of Music, a charitable institution founded in 1964 and located in downtown Victoria. The hall hosts a full calendar of classical music concerts, masterclasses, and student recitals, drawing performers and audiences from across the region. Touring cyclists exploring Victoria's cultural scene will find it a central and accessible live-music destination on Johnson Street.
